content.text: The API timeout test fails intermittently in CI. Can you investigate without changing the timeout?

summary.text: Inspecting the focused test and its synchronization points

content.text: The test races the worker-start notification. I would replace the fixed sleep with an event that the worker sets after it begins polling, then keep the production timeout unchanged. That makes the test deterministic instead of merely slower.
Sounds good. Show me the focused verification command too.

After wiring the event, run:

```bash
uv run pytest tests/server/test_timeouts.py::test_request_timeout -q
```

Run it repeatedly if you want to exercise the former race.
